summary.zh: 一块小果冻沿着进度格一格格往前跳，每落一格就把那格“踩亮”。进度卡住时它会左右张望、冒汗；到 100% 翻个跟头，撒一把彩纸。
summary.en: A little jelly hops along the progress tiles, lighting up each one it lands on. When progress stalls it looks around and sweats; at 100% it does a flip and throws confetti.

technique.zh: 一条 async 时间线串起每一跳：下蹲 → 起跳拉长 → 抛物线（x 线性、y 用两段 ease）→ 落地压扁回弹。被踩的格子下沉一下，颜色从底部灌满。百分比数字跟着落地的瞬间跳。
technique.en: One async timeline chains every hop: crouch → stretch on take-off → parabola (linear x, two eased halves on y) → squash and rebound on landing. The tile dips and fills with color from the bottom; the percentage ticks on each landing.

adapt.zh: 接真实进度时，把“跳到第几格”绑到下载 / 上传进度上，卡住超过 1.5 秒再触发张望。
adapt.en: Bind the target tile to real progress; trigger the look-around only after ~1.5s without change.
